ledger/P1.note: Reordered checks only change which exception is raised when src==dst and another condition also holds; L3 allows any listed one (all are LedgerError subclasses).

ledger/P2.note: Merged loop debits 'a' before discovering 'b' cannot pay; split_fee raises InsufficientFunds but balance(a)=4, house=1.

ledger/P3.note: Prefix-difference formula gives the +1 cents to the LAST names in sorted order instead of the first: fee_shares([a,b],1) -> {a:0,b:1}.

ledger/P4.note: divmod rewrite is behaviourally identical (bool adds as int).

ratelimit/P1.note: bisect_left keeps a request at exactly t-window as live; allow('k',10) returns False and remaining returns 0.

ratelimit/P2.note: keys() order is unspecified by R7.

ratelimit/P3.note: Queues are always sorted (clock monotone), so counting expired entries equals the prefix length.

ratelimit/P4.note: remaining() performs the same tick+prune; <=0 equivalent to len>=capacity.

intervals/P1.note: bisect_right with [x, inf] finds last interval with start<=x; equivalent.

intervals/P2.note: Pure refactor of the merge condition.

intervals/P3.note: Partition into left/touching/right is correct for sorted disjoint intervals; fuzzing found no differences.

intervals/P4.note: lo<=hi keeps empty remainders; intervals() returns [(0,0),(5,10)], an empty pair in the canonical form.

pricing/P1.note: gross*90//100 floors the total rather than the discount: line_total(1,11)=9 instead of 11-floor(1.1)=10; checkout discount 2 instead of 1.

pricing/P2.note: UnknownCoupon subclasses PricingError; clamp was redundant since amount < minimum <= after_bulk.

pricing/P3.note: Greedy floor division yields non-decreasing parts differing by <=1 summing to total; reversed is non-increasing.

depgraph/P1.note: D1 names GraphError for self-dependency; CycleError was merely a subclass.

depgraph/P2.note: FIFO queue is not greedy-smallest: order() gives [a,c,b] instead of [a,b,c].

depgraph/P3.note: Same layers computed from depths; empty graph gives [].

depgraph/P4.note: min() over a ready set equals heap pop.
